JUDGMENT
                                                   NON-REPORTABLE  
                IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
                 CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
         CIVIL APPEAL NOS.8632-8634 OF 2010
    LAL BABU DAS & ORS.
               ... APPELLANT(S)
                VS.
    OIL INDIA LTD. & ANR.                   ... RESPONDENT(S)
     J U D G M E N T
ANIL R. DAVE, J.
1.
Heard the learned counsel.
2.
Upon perusal of the record and the sale instances, we 
find that the valuation arrived at by the Reference Court 
was  more  just  and  therefore,  we  set  aside  the  impugned 
judgment delivered by the High Court and restore the order 
passed by the Reference Court under Section 18 of the Land 
Acquisition Act, 1984.
3.
The  appeals  stand  disposed  of  as  allowed  with  no 
order as to costs.  Pending applications, if any, stand 
disposed of.
